WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total
  FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(tt.total AS FLOAT) as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM shares
),
differences AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.telescope_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - a.avg_val as difference
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    difference,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) as rn
  FROM differences
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
  OR difference = (
    SELECT difference 
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) as rn
      FROM differences
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 10
  )
ORDER BY difference DESC
